'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Noah Dockendorf LS You Can Either Profit By This Or Be Destroyed''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Noah Dockendorf]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This Or Be Destroyed / Or Be Destroyed]]
* '''Username:''' An_Idea
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
